title: Management requests
description: Changes to Management-owned slices (roster, economy, contracts, reputation, unlocks) requested by the strategic layer: contract offers, player services at a location, op launches (fees per op), op returns, plant output, the daily rollover and reputation-relevant strategic acts. Management validates and applies each one and returns a result per request; it publishes the resulting state in management_view (MGT-072). Spec: STR-004, STR-015, STR-029, STR-039..STR-044, STR-093, MGT-001, MGT-002..MGT-005, MGT-011, MGT-036, MGT-039..MGT-051, MGT-056..MGT-060, MGT-064, MGT-068, MGT-070, MGT-076 (payload fields and handling per type).

results.description: Management's answer, one per request; a debit the balance cannot cover returns ok false (MGT-070); launchOp ok false = the op does not launch (MGT-005). acceptContract and missionOutcome return paymentDue; Strategic deducts it from the employer's funds and sends contractPayment, only then Management credits the player (STR-093, MGT-047).

feesUsd.description: launchOp: the soldiers' fees per op (by rank; a helicopter pilot is one of the soldiers), paid at launch (MGT-005)

amountUsd.description: hire, trade, barter, vehicleTrade, hospital, repair, refuel, buyFob, handIn: money moved, debit negative, credit positive (MGT-076)

soldierId.description: hire: the new roster soldier's id (MGT-001)

type.description: Payload fields and Management's handling per type: MGT-076

offer.description: contractOffer: the offer to store in contracts with status offered (STR-044, MGT-041, MGT-042)

reason.description: contractEnded; employerDefault = advance kept, no debt (MGT-048); taken = a rival PMC took the unsigned offer, which leaves the board (MGT-052)

employer.description: contractPayment: the faction whose funds paid (STR-093)

location.description: Region or POI where it happens (hire and localRecruits: the town or Krug market of a local pool; trade, barter, vehicleTrade, handIn, hospital, repair, refuel, buyFob: where the service is used)

faction.description: payCompensation, payOffBounty, payKrugPass (krug), payKrugEscort (krug): the receiving faction; buyIntel: the seller; reputationAct: the faction the act directly affects, absent for warCrime (every faction; sellSupplies: the buyer); handIn: the faction the items are handed to (MGT-060, MGT-076)

count.description: reputationAct: how many times (default 1; killSoldier: soldiers killed in one fight, capped by repActs.killCapPerFight); localRecruits: candidates added (MGT-058, MGT-076)

candidateId.description: hire: the candidate taken from the hiring pool at fobId or location (MGT-002, MGT-076)

feeDiscount.description: localRecruits: feeDiscount of the added candidates (refugee recruits, STR-065 params.recruitFeeDiscount); absent = 0 (MGT-001, MGT-003)

trader.description: trade, barter: traders[].id of the faction trader; absent = the Krug market at location (MGT-039, MGT-040)

sell.description: trade: items sold, from the stash at fobId or the squad's containers and vehicle storage (ITM-022)

dealId.description: barter: the daily barter deal taken (ITM-023; deal IDs are Management's)

vehicleInstance.description: vehicleTrade: the PMC vehicle sold; repair, refuel: the vehicle serviced; opReturn: the squad's vehicle (DAT-004, MGT-076)

instances.description: repair: item instance IDs of the weapons repaired (DAT-004, DAT-014, MGT-067)

size.description: buyFob: city size, the management-rules fobPrices key (MGT-066)

loot.description: opReturn: what the squad's containers and vehicle storage hold on arrival beyond the soldiers' equipment; carrier = soldier or vehicle instance (MGT-035)

hpLost.description: contaminationTick: HP lost by each listed soldier this tick, spread evenly over all body zones (STR-097, MGT-010, MGT-076)

moraleChanges.description: moraleChange: per-soldier morale change, applied then clamped to 0..100 (STR-047, MGT-076)

modifierId.description: priceModifier: ID of the modifier (e.g. the event instance); a later request with the same ID replaces it, factor 1 ends it (MGT-076)

target.description: priceModifier: which prices the factor applies to (STR-062, STR-063, MGT-076)

regions.description: priceModifier: tiles where it applies; absent = everywhere (MGT-076)

insuredItems.description: launchOp: item instance IDs insured for this op (MGT-036)

fate.description: soldierFate: the status of the listed soldiers who did not reach an FOB, rolled by Strategic from who holds the battle tile (MGT-011); returned = an MIA or captured soldier comes back (active again, at fobId); battle_result leftMap stays active (MGT-001)

items.description: plantOutput: items delivered; handOver, handIn: items handed over (MGT-076)

missionKey.description: missionOutcome: the contractOffer missions[].key of the mission (MGT-042, MGT-044)

outcomeReason.description: missionOutcome failure: a rival PMC completed it first: no pay, no reputation loss (MGT-052, MGT-056)

act.description: reputationAct: the act, named by its management-rules repActs key (MGT-056..MGT-060)

plantId.description: plantOutput: the held plant POI that delivers (STR-015, MGT-068)

fobId.description: plantOutput: the receiving PMC FOB (STR-015); soldierFate returned: the FOB the soldier rejoins at; launchOp: the FOB the op starts from, where insured items return (MGT-036); healingTick without soldiers: every active soldier resting at that FOB heals (MGT-010)

krugMarkets.description: dailyRollover: IDs of every tile flagged krugMarket at that check (STR-005); Management moves the Krug prices of exactly these markets and drops the price lists of markets not listed (MGT-040, spec choice)

krugMarketKinds.description: dailyRollover: market tile ID -> kind for every listed krugMarkets entry (city = small or large city, town = town incl. village variant); picks the stock share when a market's stock is first rolled (MGT-040)

hours.description: healingTick: hours of recovery outside battle (MGT-010)

atFob.description: healingTick: the group heals at an FOB (x recovery.fobFactor, Trauma surgeon fobHealFactor; MGT-010)

itemRef.description: Items in a request (spec choice, cleanup 2026-11-24): instance = one specific item instance (DAT-004 instance id; count 1); without it, count items of that definition

condition.description: opReturn loot: as in battle_result loot

carrier.description: opReturn loot: the soldier or vehicle instance carrying it

contractOffer.description: Local copy of strategic_commands.schema.json $defs/contractOffer (0.6.0); keep the two identical (no cross-file refs, shared/schema.js).

id.description: Offer ID, unique per campaign; acceptContract.contractId and MGT refer to it

targetFaction.description: The faction the missions act against, if any (reputation acts, MGT-056)

sourceGoal.description: The STR-018 goal the offer serves (MGT-043)

key.description: Per-mission key, unique within the offer (two missions of one type are told apart by it)

reputationGain.description: Reputation with the employer on success (MGT-056)

reputationGate.description: MGT-055 contract flags set by the offering faction: better = Friendly or better only, sensitive = Trusted only
